purpose: Original three-part editorial illustration series for the Campus Profes how-it-works section.

assets.name: profes-encuentra-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape editorial illustration for the first of three matching feature cards on Campus, a university professor discovery website. Primary request: a young adult university student finding a professor for a course. Scene: a carefully art-directed miniature university study scene, a student seated at a simple desk using an open laptop, three small floating professor profile cards with abstract portrait shapes and short blank embossed bars, one card gently highlighted by a translucent sky-blue magnifying lens. Make this a complete visual scene, not an isolated icon. Style: sophisticated tactile 3D editorial illustration, sculpted matte clay and folded ivory paper, soft ceramic forms and subtle translucent acrylic accents. Friendly, human, contemporary, premium craft. Color palette: Campus deep navy #112633, sky blue #17b6e7, ivory, soft powder blue; solid very pale blue #e6f3f8 studio backdrop, no border. Composition: landscape 3:2, orthographic three-quarter view, compact sculptural arrangement in the central 75 percent of the frame, clear readable silhouette, generous 10 percent safety margins, beautiful subtle contact shadows, eye-level slightly elevated camera. Lighting: large soft studio daylight from upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, refined material texture, crisp detail. The student is an adult with warm medium skin, dark hair, navy and ivory casual clothing, simplified expressive face. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or UI screenshots. No excessive decorative symbols, no photorealism, no glossy plastic, no harsh outlines. This is a coherent university illustration series, keep the style and camera consistent.
